gateway.description: The Atlassian API gateway for one Jira Cloud site.

cloud_id.description: The cloud ID of the Jira Cloud site. Resolved from ATLASSIAN_CLOUD_ID when set; SELECT cloud_id FROM jira.atlassian_tenant.info WHERE site = '<site>' answers it.

site.description: A Jira Cloud site, addressed by its subdomain (the part before .atlassian.net).
The site subdomain, e.g. acme for https://acme.atlassian.net.
